tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'gugs byang gnubs lugs su grags pa ni/ 1$0000300na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas// sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin// dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa dang*// phrin las 'jam dpal shor sang nyi ma khros// gshin rje gshed po king kang dmar nag dang*// las kyi mtha' sdud nag po ti pa tsa// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin smod/ khyad par sngags 'chang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag /rgyu sbyor mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la// snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la sems// da lta gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ kha 'jam snying rtsub zhe nas dmod pa dang*// do bsdos phod btsugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed// mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du snyog /'gro lam rtsang 'dzug za lam dug sbyor gshom// ming yig gzugs ling bkod pa 'di rnams kyi// rnam shes bla tshe srog dang bcas pa rnams// gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab gseng*// nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i skyabs// gang na gnas kyang liṅga 'di nyid la/ khug cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ rke nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐// yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ// myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dgra bo srung skyob byed pa'i lha srung rnams// phyes shig badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa// dbyer med stims shig ā we sha ya ā//
